callees.name: _validate_plugin_json_content
callees.signature: _validate_plugin_json_content(plugin_dir: Path, name: str, data: dict) -> Optional[PluginConfig]
callees.pre_condition: plugin_dir is a pathlib.Path pointing to a directory containing plugin.json, name is the directory name of plugin_dir (non-empty string), and data is a dict parsed from plugin.json.
callees.post_condition: Returns None if data fails PluginConfig validation rules (name in data is non-empty, version is a valid string, and for every stage in stages the stage type is valid and its required fields are non-empty). Returns a PluginConfig whose name attribute is non-empty when data satisfies all validation rules.
